categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and edits `contrib/guix/guix-build`, which manages Guix reproducible builds.
categories.rationale: Fixes an active Guix build failure on master. Per the PR description, exporting `GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH` caused local modules to leak outside the pinned Guix execution, leading to build failure #36530.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly delegates build and release scripts to the build category.
categories.rationale: Guix build scripts belong to the build category rather than tools.
